description: Deterministic safety and liveness cases for the fixed v1 direct-conversation operation-control PBFT profile.

fixed_profile.one_vote_per_replica: one semantic value/lock digest per stable pair slot, instance predecessor, view, phase and replica
fixed_profile.pair_slot: pair_registry_id equals H(pair-slot label,{trust_domain_id,pair_key}); slot_version is permanently 1

vectors.accept: The configured trust-domain root signs a complete policy statement; prepare_authorization performs the stable pair-slot single-write CAS and returns one deterministic registry statement/core. One-vote slots share the predecessor head and omit operation_id, origin_coordinator is replicas[0], proposer is replicas[view mod N], and requester authorization fixes operation/genesis. EffectValueCore excludes view/certificates and carries a closed typed effect plus complete host transition. PREPARE binds H(pre-prepare label,exact signed PRE-PREPARE), COMMIT binds exact prepared certificate; view 0 forbids NEW-VIEW and view>0 requires a byte-identical NEW-VIEW proposal.
vectors.reject: Opaque/unsigned policy, a second different registry core for one pair slot, origin coordinator outside replicas, two operation IDs treated as separate genesis slots, wrong proposer, opaque effect details, missing host DID, value core containing view/certificate fields, PREPARE or COMMIT without its exact lock digest, prepared certificate lacking PRE-PREPARE, view 0 with NEW-VIEW, view>0 without NEW-VIEW, mismatched nested proposal, cross-phase signature, or NEW-VIEW ignoring highest prepared value.

vectors.accept: journal_root is the domain-separated digest of the complete closed RFC9180 HPKE envelope, committing suite, recipient/key, enc, plaintext schema, AAD and ciphertext. AAD omits value/journal/ciphertext to avoid a cycle; authenticated decryption cross-binds the exact allowed payload and full typed effect digest. Stable qDA/prepared/qCOMMIT semantic digests exclude witness arrays, while every exact-q witness is verified. effect_head excludes qCOMMIT. Destination CAS compares effect_commitment_digest, so different valid signer subsets are duplicate witnesses for one effect.
vectors.reject: Effect execution from a read certificate, fewer than q distinct signers, arbitrary registered-operation effect, wrong request schema/digest/authorization projection, HPKE scheme/key/enc/AAD/schema substitution under one ciphertext, self-referential digest, treating two valid quorum subsets as equivocation, later cancel of q-committed effect, or a bundle treated as a second commit point.

vectors.accept: A read certificate embeds the exact signed registry-bound request (lifetime <=60s, skew <=5s) and exactly q distinct canonical-sorted unexpired receipts with one byte-identical complete registry/pair/host-DID+epoch head. minimum_host_epoch is ordered; optional expected_host_service_id is exact, and omission discovers a certified successor DID. A committed head carries effect ID/commitment/value/effect-head/qCOMMIT coordinates sufficient for by_committed_head exact bundle recovery.
vectors.reject: Treating a DID as a numeric minimum, returning an epoch below minimum, violating an explicitly expected host, execution from a local replica head, split-brain heads, a committed head that cannot address a recovery query, scanning external candidates, or deleting a post-genesis operation because the journal carrier is temporarily incomplete.

vectors.accept: Before genesis quorum no canonical operation/effect exists; after q COMMIT the stable operation and coordinates recover. Destination CASes (pair_registry_id,operation_id,attempt_sequence,effect_id) by semantic commitment and deferred bytes plus dependencies are durable. Attempt advance is committed in the old attempt with outer sequence=from, inner operation equal, to=from+1, and its HPKE plaintext carries exact cleanup receipt and fresh claim authorization. Host transfer plaintext carries the dual-signed exact manifest; destination and receipt equal the resulting host fence.
vectors.reject: Two genesis operations for one pair/head, a second claim in one attempt, outer/inner operation mismatch, outer sequence equal to_attempt, to_attempt not from+1, cleanup/authorization/claim digest mismatch, host manifest substitution, transfer destination not to_host, delivery receipt host not resulting host, missing +1 fence, initial head containing transfer_id, operation-control sent through another carrier, vague bundle query, different semantic commitments treated as duplicate, valid witness bytes treated as equivocation, or deferred before durable storage.
